extras: The Immich Album Share Key must be kept private, as it grants read access to the entire shared album.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows users to easily insert images from their self-hosted Immich instance into their Obsidian notes.
problem: Users need a way to easily reference and embed photos and videos managed by a separate self-hosted photo server like Immich within their Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin allows users to easily insert images from their self-hosted Immich instance into their Obsidian notes.

summary: Allows users to insert images and videos from a self-hosted Immich instance into Obsidian notes via hotlinking or local download.
